cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Choose What Matters More
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between emotional safety and the outcome they claim to want.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They're calling your audition number. We'll go in now; I'll do the introductions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I want the part. I don't want them laughing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then choose: I'll walk you in, or drive you home.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Walk me in, but promise they won't laugh.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stay beside you. The rest I can't promise. Are we going in?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 leads entry confidently; A3 yields which help B receives; A5 substitutes staying for guaranteed safety while still requiring B choose the audition risk.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 wants a part without laughter; A3 can offer transport and A5 presence, neither falsely guarantees the panel reaction.

relationship.evidence: B2 names a concrete performance fear and B4 bargains for protection while choosing to enter.

heightening.evidence: B4 impossible guarantee causes A5 to limit the promise and renew the decision.

specificity.evidence: A1 number called establishes immediate audition stakes; B2 explicitly wants the part.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 support, limit and decision are all needed to answer B4 conditional agreement without a lesson summary.
